description: Get CCPEDIA's CONTENT-CATALOG metrics: how many Canton items CCPEDIA has indexed. Counts of CIPs (total/in-review/final), forum topics & posts, GitHub issues/PRs, dev-fund proposals, docs pages, videos, blog posts, mailing threads, and radar items. This is CCPEDIA coverage/inventory, NOT live Canton on-chain stats. For on-chain validators/rounds use get_network_state, for price/TVL use get_token_market.
name: get_network_stats
